title: Claude
tagline: Anthropic's AI assistant, known for nuanced reasoning and long context windows.
description: Claude is built by Anthropic with a focus on safety and helpfulness. It handles extremely long documents (up to 200K tokens), writes in a natural voice, and excels at careful analysis and instruction-following. Claude.ai offers a free tier; Claude Pro at $20/month gives priority access to the latest models.
metaDescription: Claude AI review: pricing, pros, cons, and who it's best for. Compare Claude to ChatGPT and other AI assistants.
pros: Strong safety and reduced hallucination rate
cons: Web search is limited on free tier
